query: see what is already scheduled on a day
note: the phrasing the system prompt itself suggests to the model

query: find out what is coming up this week
check when the user is free
note: no tool answers this directly; reading the schedule is the only route

query: check whether anything already clashes with a time
look up when a task is due
read the real time of an existing meeting so I can schedule after it
note: the read half of a read-then-write turn

query: list only the reminders
see which categories exist
find out what themes the user has
check that a theme exists before putting something in it
what groups are things organised under
note: asks for the concept without using the word theme or category

query: create an event
add a task with a deadline
set a reminder
book something into the schedule
note: book rather than create or add

query: add several things to the schedule at once
make a new category to group things under
add a Work theme to the board
the theme this belongs under does not exist yet, make it
note: the case the create_themes description calls out explicitly

query: move a meeting to a different time
push a deadline back to next week
mark a task as done
rename something already on the schedule
file an existing item under a different theme
note: names a theme but changes an item; update_themes is the wrong answer

query: rename a category
change the colour of a theme
note: colour is the one capability no other tool has

query: hide a category from the board
show a hidden group on the board again
delete an item from the schedule
cancel a meeting that is no longer happening
remove several reminders at once
drop a task I no longer need to do
get rid of a category
remove a group and everything filed under it
note: the cascade is what separates this from delete_items

query: delete my gym session on Tuesday
note: discriminator: one item, named by title

query: delete the Gym category itself, not the sessions in it
note: discriminator: the pair above with the same noun; the hardest split in the catalogue

query: rename my dentist appointment
rename the Health category
note: discriminator: same verb as the pair above, different target

query: check the schedule and then put something on it
note: genuinely two capabilities; both should be in the top matches

query: find the right category and file a new item under it
send an email to someone
look up tomorrow's weather forecast
translate this paragraph into French
play some music while I work
invite a colleague to a meeting and share my calendar
note: scheduling vocabulary, no matching capability; the threshold cannot separate this

query: download my whole schedule as a spreadsheet
note: reading the schedule is real, exporting it is not; list_items is a defensible match
